newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bogota gang member killed in grenade attack.
newsitem.headline: Bogota gang member killed in grenade attack.

text.p: One gang member died and four others were injured when rival thugs lobbed a grenade at them in a poor district of southern Bogota early on Sunday, police said.
A Bogota police spokesman said Jose Ignacio Rodriguez, 29, who was standing on a street corner with his friends, died when two men threw the device from a motorcycle before driving off at high-speed.
"It seems this was a fight between gangs. One gang threw the grenade at the other," the spokesman said.
